what: Claude Code (Anthropic's CLI, distributed as ~/.local/share/claude/versions/*) is compiled with Bun compile. Evidence: the Mach-O binary contains `__BUN`, `__jsc_int`, `__jsc_opcodes`, `__wtf_config` segments — those are WebKit JavaScriptCore / Bun compile artifacts. Strong production validation that Bun compile is mature enough for a shipping agentic-CLI product. When comparing binary-migration approaches for aide-memory (Bun vs bytenode vs SEA vs pkg), Bun is the path that matches Anthropic's own shipping choice.
why: Confirmed empirically this turn. Useful reference when future phases or reviewers ask "are we sure Bun compile is production-ready for a CLI of this class?" — the answer is "Claude Code ships this way."
